title: OotleEscrow
creator: junnn / JUNNN26
summary: November 27, 2026: The Rust template fixes buyer, seller, payment resource, exact amount, deadline and arbitrator at creation. Its public simulation illustrates funding, release, refunds, disputes and deadline claims. A human arbitrator is trusted to choose the outcome of a dispute. The README and page identify the simulation; no mainnet or Esmeralda deployment is established. Creator-reported engine and simulation parity tests were not rerun. MIT source and public creator evidence were reviewed. The genuine recording is a source/docs walkthrough with scripts and downloads disabled. No repository code, installed software, wallet or transaction was executed.
cardSummary: Explore two-party trade escrow with fixed terms, release, refund, dispute and timeout paths through a walletless simulation.
